issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch for StockIngredient: The problem statement and the solution expect a constructor StockIngredient(String, int, int) (three parameters), but the template defines StockIngredient(String, int, int, boolean) (four parameters). Additionally, the template's Main uses the three-parameter constructor, which will not compile against the template StockIngredient. This inconsistency will block students from compiling and from following the class diagram in the problem statement.
issues.suggestedFix: Provide a three-parameter constructor StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity) in the template (or add an overloaded 3-arg constructor that delegates to the existing 4-arg constructor with a default strictValidation value). This will align the template with the problem statement and the solution and allow the example in Main to compile.
